title: Synthetic scenario: visual exploration before approved graphic brief
context: Synthetic advertiser example. Visual exploration begins before an approved Graphic Banner Brief, producing abstract shapes without a grounded commercial message. The case tests whether the workflow obtains the brief, first-glance takeaway, intended reaction and composition constraints before rendering directions.
required_regressions: after exact commercial-job and relevant research/category evidence, create a user-reviewable Graphic Banner Brief before first-round visual rendering

Graphic Banner Brief must freeze first-glance takeaway, desired user reaction, primary/secondary message semantics, exact CTA, brand anchor, advertising role, composition/type/color/lighting boundaries and anti-failure rules
first-round visual rendering is blocked until an exact-SHA Graphic Banner Brief decision with decided_by=USER and decision=APPROVE passes
REVISE BRIEF keeps all visual rendering blocked until updated brief bytes are approved
abstract geometry without commercial meaning and decorative form substituted for advertising idea are hard REJECT rules
hero generation is optional and cannot be the default first step for concept exploration
A/B/C concepts must differ by advertising logic before they differ by visual form
brief approval is separate from later visual selection/approval and never unlocks full production
performance_claim_policy: Graphic Banner Brief approval is a production and design-clarity control; it does not predict CTR, CVR, sales lift, or Google approval.
